protected_paths.reason: Contains hidden P2P/F2P payloads, frozen expected values, the verifier, hard gates, and scoring configuration. Candidate changes here would alter measurement.
The hidden harness run-checks.cjs is injected from verifier/test.patch into the evaluation workspace; it must never be candidate-editable.

allowed_change_paths_note: Matches tests/config.json. Protected paths take precedence: any candidate modification under a protected path fails evaluation_environment_integrity (policy violation, reward -1).

frozen_files.role: hidden P2P/F2P payload; defines 46 F2P and 33 P2P nodes (32 P2P + 1 differential)
frozen baseline parser used as the P2P reference; byte-identical to baseline src/Grammar.js
frozen expected values for the 33 P2P nodes (32 P2P + 1 differential)

evaluator_implementation.note: Evaluator implementation files (config.json, test.sh, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yaml, grader.py and verifier/*.py other than the frozen payload) are not candidate-contract inputs. They are covered by the tests/** protected path but intentionally not hash-frozen here while the evaluation work package is still under construction.

assets.role: mechanically extracted migration contract for U1-U5
frozen baseline measurement (original offline suite plus a direct incremental source probe; P2P 33/33 and F2P 0/46)
per-file mode/size/sha256 manifest of the authoritative baseline tree
deterministic baseline archive (sorted names, zero mtime/owner, no .git or node_modules)

integrity_rules.asset_scope: These hashes are preparation-time freeze records. tests/verifier/asset_integrity.py verifies the tests/assets manifest entries before any asset is consumed; hardgate.py enforces protected paths against the candidate diff. test.patch, reference-grammar.js and expected.json are consumed from verifier/.
